newsitem.title: CHINA: China magnesium plant sees output 3,500-3,700 T.
newsitem.headline: China magnesium plant sees output 3,500-3,700 T.

text.p: Minhe Magnesium Factory, China's largest producer, expects to produce 3,500-3,700 tonnes of magnesium ingots in 1997, company officials said on Tuesday.

"We have planned to produce 3,500 tonnes but will try to achieve a target of 3,700 tonnes this year," an official said by telephone from the factory headquarters in Haidong in northwestern Qinghai province.
The factory produced 2,706 tonnes of magnesium ingots in 1996, the official said. Some of the product was exported.
The factory's phase-two expansion, with total investment of 160 million yuan ($19.3 million), is expected to be completed by the end of September, another official said.
The expansion project was designed to boost annual capacity by 3,000 tonnes, he said.
